name: spoonos-community-bot
description: Modular Discord bot for the SpoonOS Community Contribution Program

scripts.dev:review: cd review-service && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --env-file ../.env
scripts.dev:local: PUBLIC_API_ENABLED=true PUBLIC_API_PORT=8787 PUBLIC_API_HOST=127.0.0.1 PORTAL_CORS_ORIGIN=http://localhost:3000 COMMUNITY_PORTAL_URL=http://localhost:3000 tsx watch src/index.ts
scripts.dev:api: PUBLIC_API_PORT=8787 PUBLIC_API_HOST=127.0.0.1 PORTAL_CORS_ORIGIN=http://localhost:3000 node --import tsx src/scripts/portal-api.ts
scripts.start:review: cd review-service && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --env-file ../.env
